finding: a plan text segment with `font` (name or numeric id) and `animation_in` (name or id) builds with exit 0, but the draft carries neither: the text material has no font field and materials contains only `texts`
why_it_matters: the same silent-drop class as the transition: the caller declares a font or an entrance animation, the build is green, and the draft simply has no such material - an automated edit cannot tell it failed
context: the ids and names used here are real catalog entries with vip=false, so this is not a bad-input case
catalogs::resolve already accepts both forms after the resource-alignment fix, so the loss is after resolution
draft.rs resolves fonts at one site; the text-segment writer is the likely place where the value is not attached
not_proven: whether the font would be dropped for a different text-segment shape (styles/range)
whether the wire format expects the font as a separate material bucket rather than a text field
